summary: Implemented rich_measure for Tree and VerticalCenter in the repository, without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/tree.py adds an iterative Tree.__rich_measure__ (explicit stack, level counter, four cells of indent per level). rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, constrains Align rendering to the measured maximum (or the smaller of that and explicit width), and adds the public VerticalCenter class with rendering, measurement, and repr. rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options while still passing justify into renderable collection. tests/test_align.py imports VerticalCenter and adds repr, render, measure, and no-attribute-error tests; tests/test_tree.py imports Measurement and adds a measurement test expecting (11, 19). CHANGELOG.md 9.8.0 is marked Unreleased with an Added list. Not verified: tests were not run and black was not run, per instructions; code was checked by reading only.
